name: Santhoshkumar R
headline: Machine Learning Engineer | Computer Vision | Cloud MLOps & Security

hero.title: Engineering Production-Ready AI/ML, GenAI & Computer Vision Systems
hero.subtitle: Machine Learning Engineer with 4.4+ years of experience designing, fine-tuning, and deploying production ML & GenAI systems across NVIDIA edge appliances (Jetson Orin Nano Super) and AWS cloud infrastructure (SageMaker endpoints, pgvector, Bedrock RAG) — combined with enterprise-grade AWS security and compliance (HIPAA & SOC 2).

paragraphs: I specialize in the bridge between applied Artificial Intelligence and robust production infrastructure. Rather than treating ML models as isolated notebooks, I build end-to-end, high-throughput systems that ingest live video feeds, perform sub-second edge/cloud inference, execute vector similarity lookups, and automatically scale under enterprise security boundaries.

At Clustrex Data Private Limited, I lead the core engineering of an AI-powered CCTV surveillance platform. This involved fine-tuning custom YOLO models on 10k annotated images, building hardware-accelerated video pipelines using GStreamer and CUDA for NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, creating real-time face recognition via InsightFace/ArcFace embeddings in PostgreSQL pgvector (HNSW), and orchestrating containerized real-time inference endpoints on AWS SageMaker (ml.g5.xlarge).

Beyond model deployment, I enforce enterprise cloud governance. As an AWS Certified Security – Specialty engineer, I design Terraform-managed cloud environments embedding HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliance controls, eliminating public SSH/bastion hosts via AWS Systems Manager (SSM) zero-trust tunneling, and protecting assets with GuardDuty, Inspector, and KMS encryption.

coreDisciplines.title: Computer Vision & Edge AI
coreDisciplines.description: Fine-tuning custom YOLO models for multi-class detection (people, PPE, carried items), hardware video decode/encode via GStreamer (nvv4l2decoder), CUDA optimization, and running 35–45 FPS inference on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano.

coreDisciplines.title: Generative AI & Video RAG
coreDisciplines.description: Integrating foundation LLMs for automated CCTV event summarization, enabling natural-language semantic RAG search across surveillance events, and conducting LoRA fine-tuning of vision-language models.

coreDisciplines.title: Vector Search & Identity Recognition
coreDisciplines.description: Extracting 512-D face embeddings with InsightFace/ArcFace, storing vectors in PostgreSQL using pgvector with HNSW indexing, and executing ultra-fast nearest-neighbor similarity search for live employee identification.

coreDisciplines.title: AWS MLOps & Scalable Deployment
coreDisciplines.description: Building containerized real-time inference endpoints on AWS SageMaker (ml.g5.xlarge), managing model artifacts with ECR and CodePipeline, and running hybrid cloud training + dual RTX 5090 local benchmarking.

coreDisciplines.title: Cloud Security & Compliance (HIPAA / SOC 2)
coreDisciplines.description: AWS Certified Security – Specialty. Architecting zero-trust EC2 access with AWS Systems Manager (SSM) ProxyCommand, eliminating public IPs and bastion hosts, automated KMS encryption, and raising security benchmark scores to 80%.

coreDisciplines.title: Infrastructure as Code & DevOps
coreDisciplines.description: Modular Terraform automation for multi-tenant AWS environments (VPC 3-tier subnets, ECS Fargate, Aurora RDS, API Gateway, WAF, Route53, and CodePipeline CI/CD) reducing operational costs by 40%.
